name: Societe Arabe Internationale de Banque (SAIB)
source: Saib Bank audited financial statements, statement of financial position, 31 December 2025 (KPMG Hazem Hassan and Kreston Egypt), page 3 of the English translation, with 2024 comparatives from the same statement and 2023 from the audited statements for the year ended 31 December 2023, page 3. Amounts are in USD, the presentation currency the bank prints in its own column headers. Assets equal liabilities plus equity to the unit in all three years. Current and non-current splits are absent because a bank statement of financial position does not present them.
